notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B product analytics + in-app help). Started with Hosted API trial (Jan-Feb) — good quality but rising cost at scale; now evaluating Dedicated to control latency/cost and for VPC requirement. Customer wants a production-ready canary + fallback routing plan.

Key quotes: "Need sub-200ms p50 on short chat flows (≤128 tokens) — p95 can be higher but must be predictable." — Head of Product.
"If a GPU node fails we must fail to a cheaper variant automatically — no manual rollcalls in middle of business day." — Platform lead.

Technical requirements / priorities:
- Workloads: chat-based in-app assistant (80% traffic), doc search + reranking (15%), nightly embeddings (5%).
- Latency targets: p50 ≤ 200ms for chat; p95 ≤ 700ms acceptable for long responses. Throughput target ~40-75 req/s during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: careful on per-token cost; looking for batching/cache suggestions to reduce bill 25-40%.
- Models: prefer open model family (LlamaX / variant) but willing to test Redwood-verified variants with quantization. Need guidance on perf vs quality tradeoffs.
- Routing: primary region us-east; require region failover to us-west + automatic fallback to a smaller cheaper model variant if capacity constrained. Canary plan must support incremental traffic (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) and automatic rollback if latency or quality regressions exceed thresholds.
- Security: SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, retention policy 90 days for PII-free logs. Data residency: US only.

POC scope (agreed during 2026-03-02 demo):
- 4-week Dedicated POC on a small reserved GPU pool (2 nodes) with VPC peering.
- Implement canary rollout for model v1.2 -> v1.3: traffic ramp schedule, golden metrics, quality checks (sampled prompt eval set).
- Implement fallback routing policy: model_variant_highperf (quantized fp16) -> model_variant_cost (int8) -> region_failover (us-west).
- Instrument cost per-token, per-request latency, and correctness (reranking nDCG on sample queries).
- Success criteria: p50 ≤ 200ms for chat in us-east at 50% traffic; cost per 1M tokens reduced ≥20% vs hosted baseline; automated rollback trigger worked in staged failure test.

POC steps & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): infra kickoff, security docs exchange (drive links), create service account + KMS key.
- Week 1: Deploy Dedicated nodes, baseline perf tests with hosted-vs-dedicated comparison, validate VPC connectivity.
- Week 2: Canary rollout (1%->5%->25%), collect quality metrics, perf monitoring dashboards in Redwood Console.
- Week 3: Simulated node failure + region failover test, validate automatic fallback to cheaper variant and rollback behavior.
- Week 4: Cost analysis, handoff + runbook for production rollouts, procurement paperwork.

Open questions / blockers to resolve:
- Final pricing for sustained reserved capacity vs burst credits (finance wants 3 options).
- Confirmation of usable GPU types in Dedicated region (A100 vs H100) and impact on quantized model perf.
- SOC2 evidence: need specific control IDs and sample logs (security asked via drive doc).
- Network egress rules require exact IPs for Redwood dedicated nodes — infra correlates.

Communications log (recent):
- 2026-02-10: Hosted API trial started (self-serve).
- 2026-02-24: First cost spike observed (~+38% month-on-month) on embeddings; flagged to AE.
- 2026-03-02: Product demo + POC scope agreed (ff_20260302_ochre-demo).
- 2026-03-05: Security pre-check call; asked for SOC2 artifacts.
- 2026-03-09: Pricing options shared (drive link), AE and SE call to align on POC infra.

Next steps (short):
- AE to lock a 4-week Dedicated POC start date (target 2026-03-16).
- SE (Riya) to send infra playbook and sample rollout config (canary yaml + SLOs).
- Security to receive SOC2 artifacts and verify KMS workflow.
